note: How recent an English test must be, quoted from each university's own English-requirements page (scripts/plan/english-validity.ts).

aston-university.quote: Tests must be taken within the last 2 years from the start date of the course you are applying to study at Aston University.

imperial-college-london.quote: Test scores are only considered valid if taken within 2 years of the intended course start date.

king-s-college-london.quote: The tests listed below are valid if they have been taken within two years of the start date of your chosen programme.

university-of-leeds.quote: We cannot accept results from an IELTS test that is over two years old at the start date of the course you intend to study.

university-of-bristol.quote: English language proficiency tests should be obtained within two years of the start date of your programme or course.

university-of-sheffield.quote: If you are presenting one of the tests listed in this section, it should have been completed no more than two years before the start date of your Sheffield course.
